french: Bonjour ! Tu es étudiant ?
english: Hello! Are you a student?

french: Et ton ami, il est où ?
english: And your friend, where is he?

french: Super. Moi, je suis au café !
english: Great. I'm at the café!

french: Tu as été malade hier ?
english: Were you ill yesterday?

french: Et vous, vous avez été en retard ce matin ?
english: And you all, were you late this morning?

french: Ce n'est pas grave !
english: That's all right!

french: Tu seras à Paris demain ?
english: Will you be in Paris tomorrow?

french: Et tes parents, ils seront là aussi ?
english: And your parents, will they be there too?

french: Bon voyage !
english: Have a good trip!

french: Tu as un chien ?
english: Do you have a dog?

french: Et ta sœur, elle a un chat ?
english: And your sister, does she have a cat?

french: Quelle famille !
english: What a family!

french: Tu as eu un cadeau pour ton anniversaire ?
english: Did you get a present for your birthday?

french: Et ton frère, il a eu un cadeau aussi ?
english: And your brother, did he get a present too?

french: Quelle chance !
english: How lucky!

french: Tu auras le temps demain ?
english: Will you have time tomorrow?

french: Et Paul, il aura le temps aussi ?
english: And Paul, will he have time too?

french: D'accord, à demain !
english: OK, see you tomorrow!

french: Qu'est-ce que tu fais ce soir ?
english: What are you doing tonight?

french: Et tes amis, qu'est-ce qu'ils font ?
english: And your friends, what are they doing?

french: Bon courage à tous !
english: Good luck, everyone!

french: Qu'est-ce que tu as fait hier ?
english: What did you do yesterday?

french: Et ta mère, qu'est-ce qu'elle a fait ?
english: And your mother, what did she do?

french: Miam, très bien !
english: Yum, lovely!

french: Qu'est-ce que tu feras samedi ?
english: What will you do on Saturday?

french: Et dimanche, vous ferez du sport ?
english: And on Sunday, will you all do some sport?

french: Excellent !
english: Excellent!

french: Vous êtes français ?
english: Are you French?

french: Et vous êtes ici en vacances ?
english: And are you here on holiday?

french: Bienvenue en France !
english: Welcome to France!

french: Tu as été en Italie cet été ?
english: Have you been to Italy this summer?

french: Et vous avez été contents du voyage ?
english: And were you happy with the trip?

french: Ça me fait plaisir !
english: I'm glad to hear it!

french: Vous serez à la fête ce soir ?
english: Will you be at the party tonight?

french: Et Julie, elle sera là aussi ?
english: And Julie, will she be there too?

french: Dommage ! À ce soir.
english: Shame! See you tonight.

french: Vous avez des enfants ?
english: Do you have children?

french: Ils ont quel âge ?
english: How old are they?

french: Quel bel âge !
english: What a lovely age!

french: Tu as eu peur pendant le film ?
english: Were you scared during the film?

french: Et tes amis, ils ont eu peur aussi ?
english: And your friends, were they scared too?

french: Ils sont courageux !
english: They're brave!

french: Tu auras ton permis cette année ?
english: Will you get your driving licence this year?

french: Et ta sœur, elle aura une voiture ?
english: And your sister, will she have a car?

french: Bonne route !
english: Safe driving!

french: Il fait beau aujourd'hui ?
english: Is the weather nice today?

french: Alors, qu'est-ce que vous faites ?
english: So, what are you doing?

french: Bonne idée !
english: Good idea!

french: Vous avez fait bon voyage ?
english: Did you have a good trip?

french: Et ce matin, qu'est-ce que vous avez fait ?
english: And this morning, what did you do?

french: Parfait !
english: Perfect!

french: Qu'est-ce que vous ferez cet été ?
english: What will you do this summer?

french: Et ton fils, il fera le voyage aussi ?
english: And your son, will he come on the trip too?

french: Bonnes vacances !
english: Have a good holiday!

french: Où est-ce que tu vas ?
english: Where are you going?

french: Tes amis vont avec toi ?
english: Are your friends going with you?

french: À tout à l'heure !
english: See you later!

french: Tu es allé au cinéma hier ?
english: Did you go to the cinema yesterday?

french: Et ta copine, elle est allée avec toi ?
english: And your girlfriend, did she go with you?

french: Chacun son plaisir !
english: Each to their own!

french: Tu iras à la plage demain ?
english: Will you go to the beach tomorrow?

french: Et vous, vous irez en voiture ?
english: And you all, will you go by car?

french: Bonne journée !
english: Have a nice day!

french: Comment est-ce qu'on dit « thank you » en français ?
english: How do you say "thank you" in French?

french: Et toi, tu dis bonjour à tes voisins ?
english: And you, do you say hello to your neighbours?

french: C'est très poli !
english: That's very polite!

french: Qu'est-ce que tu as dit à Marie ?
english: What did you say to Marie?

french: Et elle, qu'est-ce qu'elle a dit ?
english: And what did she say?

french: Ah bon ? Vous ne vous êtes pas dit grand-chose !
english: Really? You didn't say much to each other!

french: Tu diras la vérité à ta mère ?
english: Will you tell your mother the truth?

french: Et ton frère, il dira quoi ?
english: And your brother, what will he say?

french: Sage décision !
english: Wise choice!

french: Tu vois la tour Eiffel d'ici ?
english: Can you see the Eiffel Tower from here?

french: Et vous, vous voyez la Seine ?
english: And you all, can you see the Seine?

french: Montez plus haut, alors !
english: Go higher up, then!

french: Tu as vu le match hier soir ?
english: Did you see the match last night?

french: Et tes amis, ils ont vu le match aussi ?
english: And your friends, did they see the match too?

french: Chacun ses goûts !
english: Each to their own!

french: Tu verras tes grands-parents ce week-end ?
english: Will you see your grandparents this weekend?

french: Et ta sœur, elle les verra aussi ?
english: And your sister, will she see them too?

french: Bon week-end !
english: Have a good weekend!

french: Tu sais nager ?
english: Can you swim?

french: Et tes enfants, ils savent nager ?
english: And your children, can they swim?

french: Ils apprendront vite !
english: They'll learn quickly!

french: Comment tu as su la nouvelle ?
english: How did you find out the news?

french: Et Marc, il l'a su avant toi ?
english: And Marc, did he find out before you?

french: Les nouvelles vont vite !
english: News travels fast!

french: Tu sauras le résultat demain ?
english: Will you know the result tomorrow?

french: Et tes parents, ils le sauront quand ?
english: And your parents, when will they know?

french: Bonne chance !
english: Good luck!

french: Tu veux un café ?
english: Do you want a coffee?

french: Et ton ami, il veut un thé ?
english: And your friend, does he want a tea?

french: Tout de suite !
english: Coming right up!

french: Pourquoi tu as voulu partir tôt ?
english: Why did you want to leave early?

french: Et tes amis, ils ont voulu venir ?
english: And your friends, did they want to come?

french: Tant pis pour eux !
english: Their loss!

french: Qu'est-ce que tu voudras faire à Paris ?
english: What will you want to do in Paris?

french: Et ta copine, elle voudra faire du shopping ?
english: And your girlfriend, will she want to go shopping?

french: Paris vous attend !
english: Paris is waiting for you!

french: Tu viens à la fête samedi ?
english: Are you coming to the party on Saturday?

french: Vos amis viennent aussi ?
english: Are your friends coming too?

french: Parfait, à samedi !
english: Perfect, see you Saturday!

french: Tu es venu en train ?
english: Did you come by train?

french: Et ta femme, elle est venue avec toi ?
english: And your wife, did she come with you?

french: Bienvenue à tous les deux !
english: Welcome to you both!

french: Tu viendras me voir à Noël ?
english: Will you come and see me at Christmas?

french: Et tes enfants, ils viendront aussi ?
english: And your children, will they come too?

french: Quelle joie !
english: How lovely!

french: Tu peux m'aider ?
english: Can you help me?

french: Tes amis peuvent venir aussi ?
english: Can your friends come too?

french: Merci quand même !
english: Thanks anyway!

french: Tu as pu finir ton travail ?
english: Were you able to finish your work?

french: Et Sophie, elle a pu venir à la réunion ?
english: And Sophie, was she able to come to the meeting?

french: Dommage pour elle !
english: Too bad for her!

french: Tu pourras venir demain ?
english: Will you be able to come tomorrow?

french: Et vous, vous pourrez rester dîner ?
english: And you all, will you be able to stay for dinner?

french: Une autre fois, alors !
english: Another time, then!

french: Tu as besoin d'aide ?
english: Do you need help?

french: Et ton voisin, il a besoin de quelque chose ?
english: And your neighbour, does he need anything?

french: J'en ai un !
english: I've got one!

french: Tu as eu besoin d'un médecin ?
english: Did you need a doctor?

french: Et tes enfants, ils ont eu besoin de médicaments ?
english: And your children, did they need medicine?

french: Tant mieux !
english: Good!

french: Tu auras besoin de la voiture demain ?
english: Will you need the car tomorrow?

french: Et ton père, il aura besoin de la voiture ?
english: And your father, will he need the car?

french: Pas de problème !
english: No problem!

french: Tu t'intéresses à l'histoire ?
english: Are you interested in history?

french: Et ton frère, il s'intéresse à quoi ?
english: And your brother, what is he interested in?

french: C'est passionnant !
english: That's fascinating!

french: Comment tu t'es intéressé au français ?
english: How did you get interested in French?

french: Et tes amis, ils se sont intéressés au français aussi ?
english: And your friends, did they get interested in French too?

french: Pourquoi pas !
english: Why not!

french: Tu t'intéresseras au jardinage à la retraite ?
english: Will you take up gardening when you retire?

french: Et ta femme, elle s'intéressera à quoi ?
english: And your wife, what will she take up?

french: Quelle belle retraite !
english: What a lovely retirement!

french: Tu te débrouilles en français ?
english: Do you get by in French?

french: Et ta sœur, elle se débrouille en anglais ?
english: And your sister, does she get by in English?

french: Bravo à vous deux !
english: Well done, both of you!

french: Tu t'es débrouillé à l'aéroport ?
english: Did you manage at the airport?

french: Et tes parents, ils se sont débrouillés avec les bagages ?
english: And your parents, did they manage with the luggage?

french: Super !
english: Great!

french: Tu te débrouilleras sans moi demain ?
english: Will you manage without me tomorrow?

french: Et les enfants, ils se débrouilleront pour le déjeuner ?
english: And the children, will they manage lunch?

french: Parfait !
english: Perfect!

french: Tu t'ennuies le dimanche ?
english: Do you get bored on Sundays?

french: Et ton chien, il s'ennuie quand tu travailles ?
english: And your dog, does he get bored when you're working?

french: Pauvre chien !
english: Poor dog!

french: Tu t'es ennuyé pendant le concert ?
english: Did you get bored during the concert?

french: Et ta copine, elle s'est ennuyée ?
english: And your girlfriend, did she get bored?

french: C'est la vie !
english: That's life!

french: Tu ne t'ennuieras pas pendant le long voyage ?
english: Won't you get bored on the long trip?

french: Et ton fils, il s'ennuiera ?
english: And your son, will he get bored?

french: Bon voyage, alors !
english: Have a good trip, then!

french: Tu t'entraînes souvent ?
english: Do you train often?

french: Et ton équipe, elle s'entraîne le samedi ?
english: And your team, does it train on Saturdays?

french: Bon entraînement !
english: Enjoy your training!

french: Tu t'es entraîné pour le marathon ?
english: Did you train for the marathon?

french: Et ta sœur, elle s'est entraînée avec toi ?
english: And your sister, did she train with you?

french: Vous êtes prêts, alors !
english: You're ready, then!

french: Tu t'entraîneras avant l'examen ?
english: Will you practise before the exam?

french: Et tes camarades, ils s'entraîneront aussi ?
english: And your classmates, will they practise too?

french: Excellent !
english: Excellent!

french: Tu te souviens de ton premier jour d'école ?
english: Do you remember your first day at school?

french: Et ta mère, elle s'en souvient aussi ?
english: And your mother, does she remember it too?

french: Que de souvenirs !
english: So many memories!

french: Tu t'es souvenu de l'anniversaire de ta sœur ?
english: Did you remember your sister's birthday?

french: Et ton frère, il s'en est souvenu ?
english: And your brother, did he remember it?

french: Oh là là !
english: Oh dear!

french: Tu te souviendras de ce voyage ?
english: Will you remember this trip?

french: Et les enfants, ils s'en souviendront ?
english: And the children, will they remember it?

french: C'est ça, les beaux voyages !
english: That's what great trips are like!

french: Tu t'adaptes bien à ton nouveau travail ?
english: Are you settling into your new job?

french: Et tes collègues, ils s'adaptent à toi ?
english: And your colleagues, are they getting used to you?

french: Tout va bien, alors !
english: All's well, then!

french: Tu t'es adapté à la vie en France ?
english: Did you adapt to life in France?

french: Et ta famille, elle s'est adaptée aussi ?
english: And your family, did they adapt too?

french: Félicitations !
english: Congratulations!

french: Tu t'adapteras au climat là-bas ?
english: Will you adapt to the climate over there?

french: Et tes plantes, elles s'adapteront ?
english: And your plants, will they adapt?

french: Alors, laisse-les chez moi !
english: Then leave them at my place!

french: Tu te réjouis de partir en vacances ?
english: Are you excited to go on holiday?

french: Et tes enfants, ils se réjouissent aussi ?
english: And your children, are they excited too?

french: Profitez bien !
english: Enjoy it!

french: Tu t'es réjoui de la nouvelle ?
english: Were you delighted by the news?

french: Et tes grands-parents, ils se sont réjouis ?
english: And your grandparents, were they delighted?

french: Quelle belle nouvelle !
english: What lovely news!

french: Tu te réjouiras de le voir ?
english: Will you be glad to see him?

french: Et ta mère, elle se réjouira aussi ?
english: And your mother, will she be glad too?

french: Ce sera une belle journée !
english: It'll be a lovely day!

french: Tu mets un manteau aujourd'hui ?
english: Are you wearing a coat today?

french: Et ton fils, il met quoi ?
english: And your son, what is he wearing?

french: Bien couverts, tous les deux !
english: Well wrapped up, both of you!

french: Où est-ce que tu as mis les clés ?
english: Where did you put the keys?

french: Et le pain, ta sœur l'a mis où ?
english: And the bread, where did your sister put it?

french: Merci, c'est noté !
english: Thanks, got it!

french: Tu mettras la table ce soir ?
english: Will you set the table tonight?

french: Et ton frère, il mettra combien d'assiettes ?
english: And your brother, how many plates will he put out?

french: Parfait, on sera six !
english: Perfect, there'll be six of us!

french: Tu trouves ce livre intéressant ?
english: Do you find this book interesting?

french: Et ta copine, elle le trouve comment ?
english: And your girlfriend, what does she think of it?

french: Chacun son avis !
english: Everyone has their own opinion!

french: Tu as trouvé ton portefeuille ?
english: Did you find your wallet?

french: Et tes lunettes, ta mère les a trouvées ?
english: And your glasses, did your mother find them?

french: On va chercher ensemble !
english: We'll look together!

french: Tu trouveras un appartement à Paris ?
english: Will you find a flat in Paris?

french: Et tes amis, ils trouveront du travail là-bas ?
english: And your friends, will they find work there?

french: Bonne installation !
english: Good luck settling in!

french: Tu crois aux fantômes ?
english: Do you believe in ghosts?

french: Et ta grand-mère, elle y croit ?
english: And your grandmother, does she believe in them?

french: Chacun ses croyances !
english: Everyone has their own beliefs!

french: Tu as cru son histoire ?
english: Did you believe his story?

french: Et ton patron, il l'a crue ?
english: And your boss, did he believe it?

french: Quel naïf !
english: How gullible!

french: Tes parents te croiront ?
english: Will your parents believe you?

french: Et ton professeur, il te croira ?
english: And your teacher, will he believe you?

french: Dis la vérité, alors !
english: Tell the truth, then!

french: Tu parles quelles langues ?
english: Which languages do you speak?

french: Et tes voisins, ils parlent anglais ?
english: And your neighbours, do they speak English?

french: Tu as de la chance, alors !
english: You're lucky, then!

french: Tu as parlé à ton propriétaire ?
english: Did you speak to your landlord?

french: Et ta colocataire, elle lui a parlé ?
english: And your flatmate, did she speak to him?

french: Il faut lui parler vite !
english: She needs to speak to him soon!

french: Tu parleras au directeur demain ?
english: Will you speak to the manager tomorrow?

french: Et tes collègues, ils lui parleront aussi ?
english: And your colleagues, will they speak to him too?

french: Courage !
english: Hang in there!

french: Tu prends le bus pour aller au travail ?
english: Do you take the bus to work?

french: Et ta femme, elle prend le métro aussi ?
english: And your wife, does she take the metro too?

french: C'est bon pour la santé !
english: That's good for your health!

french: Qu'est-ce que tu as pris au restaurant ?
english: What did you have at the restaurant?

french: Et ton ami, il a pris quoi ?
english: And your friend, what did he have?

french: Ça a l'air délicieux !
english: That sounds delicious!

french: Tu prendras des vacances cet été ?
english: Will you take a holiday this summer?

french: Et ta sœur, elle prendra des vacances ?
english: And your sister, will she take a holiday?

french: La pauvre !
english: Poor thing!

french: Tu lis le journal le matin ?
english: Do you read the paper in the morning?

french: Et ton père, il lit le journal ?
english: And your father, does he read the paper?

french: À l'ancienne !
english: Old school!

french: Tu as lu le dernier roman de cet auteur ?
english: Have you read this author's latest novel?

french: Et ta mère, elle l'a lu ?
english: And your mother, has she read it?

french: Elle va l'adorer !
english: She's going to love it!

french: Tu liras une histoire aux enfants ce soir ?
english: Will you read the children a story tonight?

french: Et leur grand-père, il leur lira aussi ?
english: And their grandfather, will he read to them too?

french: Quelle belle soirée !
english: What a lovely evening!

french: Tu écris souvent à ta famille ?
english: Do you often write to your family?

french: Et ton cousin, il t'écrit ?
english: And your cousin, does he write to you?

french: Envoie-lui un message !
english: Send him a message!

french: Tu as écrit ta lettre de motivation ?
english: Have you written your cover letter?

french: Et ta sœur, elle a écrit son CV ?
english: And your sister, has she written her CV?

french: Bonne chance à vous deux !
english: Good luck, both of you!

french: Tu m'écriras pendant ton voyage ?
english: Will you write to me during your trip?

french: Et tes amis, ils m'écriront aussi ?
english: And your friends, will they write to me too?

french: J'ai hâte !
english: I can't wait!

french: Il fait chaud. Tu ouvres la fenêtre ?
english: It's hot. Will you open the window?

french: Et la porte, ton frère l'ouvre aussi ?
english: And the door, will your brother open it too?

french: Ah, ça fait du bien !
english: Ah, that's better!

french: Tu as ouvert tes cadeaux ?
english: Have you opened your presents?

french: Et ta petite sœur, elle a ouvert les siens ?
english: And your little sister, has she opened hers?

french: Elle est patiente !
english: She's patient!

french: Tu ouvriras ton magasin dimanche ?
english: Will you open your shop on Sunday?

french: Et la boulangerie, elle ouvrira ?
english: And the bakery, will it open?

french: Super, j'irai chercher du pain !
english: Great, I'll go and get some bread!

french: Tu fermes la porte à clé le soir ?
english: Do you lock the door at night?

french: Et tes voisins, ils ferment leur porte ?
english: And your neighbours, do they lock their door?

french: Ils ont confiance !
english: They're trusting!

french: Tu as fermé le gaz ?
english: Did you turn off the gas?

french: Et les fenêtres, ton fils les a fermées ?
english: And the windows, did your son close them?

french: On peut partir tranquilles !
english: We can leave with peace of mind!

french: À quelle heure tu fermeras le bureau ?
english: What time will you close the office?

french: Et la banque, elle fermera à quelle heure ?
english: And the bank, what time will it close?

french: Alors, dépêche-toi !
english: Then hurry up!

french: Tu perds souvent tes clés ?
english: Do you often lose your keys?

french: Et ton père, il perd ses lunettes ?
english: And your father, does he lose his glasses?

french: C'est de famille !
english: It runs in the family!

french: Vous avez perdu le match ?
english: Did your team lose the match?

french: Et l'autre équipe de ton club, elle a perdu aussi ?
english: And the other team at your club, did it lose too?

french: Au moins une victoire !
english: At least one win!

french: Tu ne perdras pas ton passeport cette fois ?
english: You won't lose your passport this time?

french: Et ta sœur, elle ne perdra pas le sien ?
english: And your sister, won't she lose hers?

french: Promis ?
english: Promise?

french: Tu gardes tes petits-enfants le mercredi ?
english: Do you look after your grandchildren on Wednesdays?

french: Et ta femme, elle les garde aussi ?
english: And your wife, does she look after them too?

french: Quelle chance pour eux !
english: How lucky they are!

french: Tu as gardé tes vieilles photos ?
english: Did you keep your old photos?

french: Et ta mère, elle a gardé tes dessins d'enfant ?
english: And your mother, did she keep your childhood drawings?

french: Comme c'est mignon !
english: How sweet!

french: Tu garderas mon chat pendant les vacances ?
english: Will you look after my cat during the holidays?

french: Et ta fille, elle gardera mes plantes ?
english: And your daughter, will she look after my plants?

french: Merci mille fois !
english: Thanks a million!
